scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && cd flask_server && uv sync
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,FLASK" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:flask"
scripts.dev:flask: cd flask_server && uv run python app.py
